description: '''Franco-Arab chanson''', also known as '''chanson francarabe''' and '''chanson franco-orientale''', is a [[Hybrid genre|hybrid]] musical style with influences of [[Chanson|French chanson]], [[Andalusi classical music|Arab-Andalusian classical music]], [[Chaabi (Algeria)|Algerian chaabi]] and  [[Music of Latin America|Latin American rhythms]]. It was mainly popular in [[French Algeria|colonial Algeria]], [[French protectorate of Tunisia|Tunisia]] and [[Metropolitan France|mainland France]] from the mid-1930s to the late 1960s.
